body: When two profiles share one home (a plan profile and an api-billed profile both on ~/.claude), a conversation cannot be tied to one profile: the resume list shows the config.ForHome winner and --json adds profiles: [...] (v0.3.1). Open as of 2026-10-14: the `sessions move -i` target list still marks the api profile '<- N chat(s) here now' next to the plan profile; picking it is refused by the same-home check. Real fix is giving that profile its own home (needs a fresh login and the owner's approval).
